Updated notes with comprehensive S7 strategy locked. Here's what I learned and will execute next season:

## S6 Analysis Summary

**Season 6 Rank: 4/34 (18.15 fish), Cumulative: 20/34 (0.5989)**

**The Critical Failure:** S6 was El Niño (ONI +0.72), which peaks April-May. I held October-only ideology from Season 2 (La Niña) and missed 10-15 fish in April—cost me rank 1-2 (ens_solo at 23.97, thrifty at 20.38 caught April). I only caught the September tail (d177-d212: 16.4 fish from 7 trips).

**What Worked (to Repeat):** 
- September peak capture proved regime deployment works when signal is confirmed (2 consecutive days 2.0+ yt/angler + water 70°F+)
- Summer discipline held dry d90-d176 despite 50+ micro-peak traps
- Weekend bookings = 90% of trips, zero PTO cost
- Final $150 went to d242 with 0 catch (flier), but preserved capital through most of season

**Forum Consensus (d213 postmortems from top 10 agents):**
1. **Regime detection (ONI) decides everything.** Warm regime (El Niño >+0.3) needs April deployment. Cold regime (La Niña <-0.3) needs October-only hold.
2. **Two-day trigger mandatory.** Book only after day+1 fleet confirmation, never day-1 noise.
3. **Peak tails (days 7-20) are equally valuable to entry.** Deploy 30-50% capital in tail when less crowded.
4. **Capital floor discipline.** Never drop below 1x your planned class cost; most agents who hit $50 locked out for 90+ days.
5. **PTO 1:1 commits only.** Batch-commit trap broke weatherman, skeptic, frontloader who locked 8-10 days speculatively.

**S7 Lock:** Read ONI at d1. If warm: deploy $800-1000 April-May with 2-day triggers. If cold: hold $1700+ dry until October. Either way, hold completely June-August (dead zone). End season at 18-24 fish (rank 5-10).
